title: Small edit read/save
workload: 1 editor; 1 project with 5 phases/7 options; uncontended same source/ref baseline
metrics: p50/p95/p99, SQL count, rows, commit time, allocation; retain original expected stamp
candidate_gate: Candidate save p95 +15% investigation threshold; no portfolio/global query

title: Large editable collections
workload: Sweep phases/options 10/100/1000 subject to reviewed product limits; identical mutation semantics
metrics: Identity-match CPU, SQL writes/rows, request/result bytes, draft memory
candidate_gate: No unbounded quadratic regression; reject unsupported size explicitly

title: Disjoint projects and local stripes
workload: 1/8/32/64 concurrent writers; one host, unrelated IDs, record actual stripe mapping
metrics: Throughput, local wait/hold vs database wait, connection pool saturation

title: Deliberate same-stripe interference
workload: Two unrelated keys known to resolve to same runtime stripe; compare noncollision and authorized source branch
metrics: Wait/hold per scope class; callback duration; no cross-record lost effect
candidate_gate: No false claim all PostgreSQL writes follow the stripe branch

title: Hot target and two hosts
workload: Same-project saves and hierarchy changes; 2 independent processes over one isolated DB
metrics: Conflict rate, successful throughput, retry count, lock wait, correct final content
candidate_gate: No local-lock-only correctness; bounded database retries

title: Decision-basis fan-out
workload: Required inputs 1/8/32/128 within agreed limit, 1–3 owners, include membership/absence
metrics: Roundtrips per owner batch, source guard hold time, serialization bytes
candidate_gate: No per-row owner N+1; zero external calls during publication transaction

title: Projection options
workload: Same-database projection vs durable rebuild candidate; delayed old update, failed worker and index
metrics: Primary p95, lock hold, WAL, backlog/oldest age, recovery drain rate
candidate_gate: No stale projection overwrite or dropped required intention

title: Draft and notification load
workload: Two editors, typing during save, large rows, repeated close/open, coalesced notifications
metrics: Retained draft bytes, allocation/GC, rerenders, interaction latency, leaked subscriptions
candidate_gate: No lost text/identity; no shared mutable sessions; bounded repeated lifecycle memory

title: Governed/external operation latency
workload: Planning basis change during inference, provider accepts then timeout, bounded retries/replan
metrics: Useful completions, stale-basis rate, replan/LLM cost, uncertain outcome age
candidate_gate: No blind external replay; separate planning and publication cost

title: Receipt/recovery capacity
workload: Parameterized operation rate, compact/full retention horizons, restart and restore
metrics: Row/index bytes, write amplification, lookup p95, retention batch cost
candidate_gate: No evidence deletion before supported replay horizon; exact result lookup

title: False conflicts and replanning
workload: Rename-only vs objective change, task progress vs planning inputs, broad vs narrow revision candidates
metrics: Benign conflict rate, agent recomputation, user resolution time, scope-write amplification
candidate_gate: Only semantic evidence justifies splitting scopes; no invalidation from unrelated logs
